title: Release highlights visual asset suite for onboarding and quickstart
creator: Avery Chen
description: Create a focused visual asset suite for the upcoming console release that supports onboarding/quickstart docs, release blog, and in-product changelog panels. Assets should cover: 1) two hero compositions (16:9): before UI and after UI, with subtle motion overlays for the blog; 2) three feature-callout strips (desktop and mobile widths) that isolate new controls and expected outcomes; 3) annotated side-by-side screenshots for the changelog micro-tours; 4) compact sprites and icon overlays for release email templates; and 5) Figma component library and export tokens (SVG/PNG/WebP) with naming conventions and 2x/3x retina variants. Deliverables must include alt text, short captions for docs, and localized text variants for en, fr, de, and ja. Follow design system tokens, 8pt grid, and ensure WCAG AA contrast for callouts. Coordinate with PM for messaging and Eng for feature flags and staging URLs.
acceptance_criteria: All hero compositions exported in 16:9 at 1920x1080 and 1280x720 (PNG + WebP)
Feature-callout strips exported for 1200x360 and 600x180 with annotations as separate PNGs
Side-by-side before/after screenshots prepared with pixel-accurate overlays and short captions (<= 140 chars)
Figma library file includes component variants, export presets, and README for content writers
Assets uploaded to Drive + linked in PR with file naming matching release asset convention
Localization variants completed for en/fr/de/ja and verification screenshots attached
deliverables: asset-manifest.csv with file hashes and captions
